_README: Operator-supplied overhead. NOT measured from the bank and NOT verifiable from it:
ADP is one payroll rail for at least five companies and mixes driver settlements
with office salaries, so no query separates an office salary from a driver's pay.
Every figure sourced here must be labelled operator-supplied wherever it is quoted.
THE ROSTER MIXES PERIODS. People are paid weekly; premises are billed monthly.
So there is no file-level period -- EVERY line carries its own 'period', and the
loader refuses to read a line that does not declare one. A single global period
was the first reading of this data and it was wrong: it priced office, yard and
shop at 52x instead of 12x, overstating fixed cost by about 6,900 a week.
Weekly is settled for the people by the mechanic lines: 50-55 hours is a week,
and monthly would put the COO at 19,200 a year. Monthly for premises is the
The shop block is EXCLUDED from trucking break-even at the operator's instruction
('we will calculate shop independently'). Recorded so the exclusion is explicit

offshore._note: operator states >30000/wk, to be confirmed. Bank shows wires to ZONEOH Freight Insights averaging 25105/wk across 2026 (20168/wk over full history). Unreconciled.

open_questions: SHOP REVENUE: what does the shop actually bill ZONE, XTRACK and AFG, per week? Without it the shop P&L has a cost side only.
SHOP PARTS: parts purchases per week. Inferred at ~12,300/wk from the events log; not confirmed.

MAINTENANCE RATE: trucking's variable model uses 0.220/mile, an estimate. Recorded shop events for 2026 imply 0.102/mile. If the lower figure is right, contribution rises and break-even falls sharply. The shop ledger settles it.
Does the 4,000/mo shop facility line cover rent alone, or utilities and consumables too? Operator marked it 'for now'.
Office, yard and shop may share one payee (13,000/mo combined). Confirm against the bank before splitting per company.
Which company pays which owner? Needed to allocate the 3,500/wk owner understatement between ZONE, XTRACK and AFG.

entities._note: The shop is a SEPARATE ENTITY, not a line of trucking overhead (operator, 2026-09-02). It sells maintenance to ZONE, XTRACK and AFG and buys parts and labour; it has its own P&L and its own break-even. Trucking carries the shop's BILLINGS as a variable cost per mile -- never the shop's own cost lines, which would double-count. On consolidation the shop's revenue eliminates against trucking's maintenance expense.

facility._note: operator said 'for now' -- may be incomplete

parts._note: NOT SUPPLIED. Recorded breakdown events for Jan-Aug 2026 total 763,325 against 335,942 of labour and facility over the same weeks; the ~427,383 gap is the shape of parts, but that is inference from a cost log, not the shop's purchase ledger.

revenue._note: NOT SUPPLIED. The Cases log records events by payer -- ZONE 654,239, STL 69,685, driver 39,401 for Jan-Aug 2026 -- but it is a breakdown COST log, and whether those figures are what the shop BILLED or what the event COST is unresolved. Needs the shop ledger.

sheet_vs_actual._note: The weekly P&L books LESS owner pay than is actually paid. Recorded here so any figure taken from the sheet can be corrected rather than quietly trusted.
sheet_vs_actual.checked: Not hidden in 'Other charges' -- that block is itemised (max truck, trailer insurance and charge, credit card, ADP fee, factoring, Loves, STL, maintenance, returned-truck tolls, freight) and carries no owner line in any week, early layout or late.
sheet_vs_actual.per_company_split_unknown: Which company pays which owner has not been stated, so the group understatement is certain and the per-company allocation is not.
